---
name: Experiment
about: Define a reproducible computational or empirical test
labels: experiment, validation
---

## Objective

What is being tested?

## Hypothesis

What outcome is expected, and why?

## Inputs

Data, model/version, parameters, source material, or other inputs.

## Procedure

List the reproducible steps.

## Measurements

What variables, metrics, invariants, or structural properties will be measured?

## Baseline

What baseline or comparison condition will be used?

## Result

Record the observed result without interpreting it beyond the evidence.

## Interpretation

What does the result support, weaken, or leave unresolved?

## Reproducibility

Record code, commit, environment, dataset/version, and relevant artifacts.
